# Just Apps

> Just Apps (also written Just Simple Apps) is an independent studio in Mumbai,
> India, founded by Owais Khan. It makes eight free apps for everyday life:
> prayer times, screen breaks, step goals, water reminders, conversational
> reminders, subscriptions, childhood vaccine records and a transparent
> Arabic-Indic clock widget. None has ads, accounts, analytics or tracking.
> The website is static HTML with no third-party scripts or cookies.

In one line: Just Apps makes eight free Android apps: prayer times, screen-time
breaks, step, water and conversational reminders, subscription tracking,
vaccine records and an Arabic-Indic clock widget. None uses ads, accounts or
tracking.

Canonical home: https://www.justsimpleapps.online/
Language: English. Updated: 2026-10-28.

## Apps in the collection

- [Namaaz Reminder](https://www.justsimpleapps.online/namaaz-reminder): daily
  prayer times for cities in India, a live countdown to the next salah, and
  optional adhan reminders. Works offline from the last saved schedule. No
  location permission is requested; the chosen city name is the only location
  data. Android 7.0 and later. Free, no ads, no account.
  [Namaaz Reminder v1.7.2 APK](https://github.com/owaiskhan-ash/Namaaz-Reminder/releases/download/v1.7.2/NamaazReminder-1.7.2-release.apk).
- [Screen Time Reminder](https://www.justsimpleapps.online/screen-time-reminder): counts
  continuous phone use and sends one gentle break reminder when a session runs
  long, with a 7-day history. No streaks or scores, and no internet permission.
  Android 8.0 and later. Free and ad-free.
  [Screen Time Reminder v1.2.6 APK](https://github.com/owaiskhan-ash/ScreenTime-Reminder/releases/download/v1.2.6/ScreenTimeReminder.apk).
- [Subscription Tracker](https://www.justsimpleapps.online/subscription-tracker):
  manually record subscriptions and recurring bills, see normalized monthly and
  yearly totals, and get on-device reminders before a renewal. It does not
  connect to a bank. Android 8.0 and later. Free, offline, private.
  [Subscription Tracker v1.2.0 APK](https://github.com/owaiskhan-ash/Subscription-Tracker/releases/download/v1.2.0/subscription-tracker-v1.2.0.apk).
- [Vaccine Routine](https://www.justsimpleapps.online/vaccine-routine): an
  offline-first vaccine log and reminder for babies, with India's National
  Immunization Schedule offered as optional suggestions, not medical advice.
  Android and web. Free, private, no account.
  [Vaccine Routine v1.0 APK](https://github.com/owaiskhan-ash/vaccine-Tracker/releases/download/v1.0/Vaccine-Routine-1.0.apk).
- [Water Reminder](https://www.justsimpleapps.online/#water-reminder): a simple
  water-drinking nudge, every two hours by default and aligned to the local
  clock. Choose a 1, 2, 3 or 4 hour interval and optional quiet hours (10 PM to 8 AM).
  It has no intake logging, counters or charts, and makes no network requests.
  Android 7.0 and later. Free, no account.
  [Project](https://github.com/owaiskhan-ash/Water-Reminder) and
  [Water Reminder v1.0.0 APK](https://github.com/owaiskhan-ash/Water-Reminder/releases/download/v1.0.0/Water-Reminder-v1.0.0.apk).
- [Step Reminder](https://www.justsimpleapps.online/#steps-reminder): a daily
  step counter with a chosen target (2,000 to 20,000), one reminder at a chosen
  hour, and an on-device seven-day history. Android 6.0+ and web; web reminders
  fire only while the app is open. No account, cloud, analytics, Google Fit or
  Health Connect. [Project](https://github.com/owaiskhan-ash/Steps-Reminder) and
  [Step Reminder v1.4.0 APK](https://github.com/owaiskhan-ash/Steps-Reminder/releases/download/v1.4.0/SC-Step-Reminder-1.4.0.apk).
- [RemindME](https://www.justsimpleapps.online/#remindme): a conversational
  reminder app that parses natural-language phrases with an explicit date and
  time and schedules alarms on Android's alarm audio stream so silent or
  vibrate mode never mutes a reminder. Supports seven languages (English,
  Bahasa Indonesia, Español, Português, हिन्दी, العربية with RTL, and 简体中文),
  includes Snooze 10 min and Mark done notification actions, a persistent
  three-tab bottom dock (Home, Previous, Settings), dark mode by default, and
  automatic alarm restoration after reboot. Reminder text and settings stay in
  local storage on the phone. Android 8.0 and later. Free, no account.
  [Project](https://github.com/owaiskhan-ash/RemindME) and
  [RemindME v1.0.6 APK](https://github.com/owaiskhan-ash/RemindME/raw/v1.0.6/release/RemindME-v1.0.6.apk).
- [Arabic Clock](https://www.justsimpleapps.online/#arabic-clock): a 100%
  transparent Android home-screen (and supported lock-screen) clock widget that
  renders local 24-hour time in Arabic-Indic numerals (٠١٢٣٤٥٦٧٨٩) even when
  your phone language is English. Includes six bundled offline fonts (Amiri,
  Scheherazade, Janna LT Bold, Arslan Wessam A, 18 Khebrat Musamim and Avenir
  Heavy), numeral width stretch, HUGE fill-space mode, stacked hours-over-minutes,
  full-range opacity, and hollow or solid font outlines. Requests no internet
  permission and stores settings locally. Android 8.0 and later. Free, no account.
  [Project](https://github.com/owaiskhan-ash/Arabic-Clock-For-Android-) and
  [Arabic Clock v2.3.0 APK](https://github.com/owaiskhan-ash/Arabic-Clock-For-Android-/releases/download/v2.3.0/Arabic-Clock-2.3.0.apk).

## Facts worth quoting

- All eight apps are free and ad-free; none has in-app purchases or requires a login.
- Personal records are stored on the device, not on a server.
- Screen Time Reminder, Water Reminder and Arabic Clock do not request Android's
  internet permission and make no network requests.
- Step Reminder makes no runtime network requests; step data, goals and history
  stay on the device.
- RemindME parses and stores reminders entirely on the device; it only uses the
  network if you opt into the RemindME alarm sound instead of the default
  device alarm, falling back to the device alarm when offline.
- The site sets no cookies and loads no third-party fonts, scripts or trackers.
- Namaaz Reminder does not request Android's location permission.
- Namaaz Reminder sends only the selected city name, the country (India) and a
  calculation-method number to api.aladhan.com to fetch timings.
- Supported platforms: Android 7.0+ (Namaaz Reminder and Water Reminder),
  Android 8.0+ (Screen Time Reminder, Subscription Tracker, RemindME and Arabic
  Clock), Android 6.0+ and web (Step Reminder), Android and web (Vaccine Routine).
